23. 若 0° < x < 90° ，則下列何者必為正確？

I. tan x tan(90° – x) = 1
II. sin x – sin(90° – x) < 0
III. cos x + cos(90° – x) > 0

A. 只有 I 及 II
B. 只有 I 及 III
C. 只有 II 及 III
D. I、II 及 III
reasoning:
Given 0° < x < 90°:
I. tan(90° - x) = cot x = 1/tan x, so tan x * tan(90° - x) = tan x * (1/tan x) = 1. This statement is always true.
II. sin(90° - x) = cos x. The statement sin x - cos x < 0 is only true if x < 45°. Since the given range is 0° < x < 90°, it is not necessarily true (e.g., if x = 60°, sin 60° - cos 60° = √3/2 - 1/2 > 0).
III. cos(90° - x) = sin x. In the first quadrant (0° < x < 90°), both sin x and cos x are positive, so their sum sin x + cos x is always greater than 0. This statement is always true.
Therefore, only statements I and III are necessarily correct.
